pairs.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/output_assertions.rs:486 No test reaches the branch that counts critical failures and drives the Completed-to-Incomplete downgrade. That is the branch output_assertion.rs:76-78 records as having silently never fired before. evaluate_assertions has no caller in any test (only execution.rs:2337 calls it), and the module's fixture hard-codes severity "warning" (:626). Deleting or inverting this branch would leave the suite green.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/output_assertions.rs:486 The tests drive only the pure evaluate_one. The severity decision and its downgrade payload are never executed.

src-tauri/engine/src/output_assertions.rs:626 The only fixture pins severity to warning, so it carries none of the critical-path data the module exists to act on. The db template (init_test_db) that evaluate_assertions needs is never used in this module.

src-tauri/engine/src/rate_limiter.rs:218 This assertion relies on a real 50 ms window still being open, and the same file uses thread::sleep(60ms) for expiry (:220). A stall over 50 ms on a loaded runner flips it red with no defect. An injected clock would assert the schedule instead.
